_comment: Curated compatibility of catalog programs. Default (absent): status 'runs' = starts and runs without errors in the automated sweeps on both runtimes (tools: SweepTest/SweepTests, -Dtempleos.sweep=Catalog). 'unsupported' programs are excluded from executable lists; the historical Games page shows them as source-only entries. Evidence: docs/game-compatibility.md and docs/graphics-compatibility.md.

demo.polezeros.note: original drag and phase behavior runs in both engines; full-screen recalculation is slow in HolyC mode (see simulator/host evidence)

app.titanium.note: starts and plays briefly, then stops with a memory fault while drawing

game.talons.note: needs 72 MiB of program memory (devices with more RAM); generates terrain for a minute or more before play

demo.predatorprey.note: very slow on the interpreter (about one frame per second)

source.demo.datetime.note: Original source and genuine native execution verified in Swift and Kotlin; bounded output/input/menu/audio/exit tests, not full-system compatibility.
